# The Underground
The [color=#d93c3c]Underground[/color] is the sector's black market: a neutral faction working out of a hidden station deep in the [color=orange]Outer Cloud[/color]. It sells to anyone and answers to no one.
It is led by the [color=purple]Godfather[/color], who has up to five [color=crimson]Fugitives[/color] working for them. They move goods the Trans-Solarian Federation has banned, for profit and to wear down its hold on the sector.
## Where you stand
- The [color=cyan]TSFMC[/color] pays a bounty for you [bold]alive[/bold]. They have to make a demand first, and they can't raid the station without admin permission. - The [color=tan]PDV[/color] buys from you and hires you. The Sultanate may still mark you a heretic. - Civilians are your customers. Invite them to dock and they are under the market truce. - The Reavers leave your ships, your crews and your station alone.
[bold]Read [textlink="Conflict Rule 7" link="WGRuleConflictSevenUnderground"]. It covers captures, bail, the station, the market truce and what you can be hired for.[/bold]
## Smuggling
The Underground runs on [color=red]telecrystals[/color], which ship in illegal items from the greater Perseus Arm. The UndergroundVend in the armory holds them and sells those items.
[color=crimson]Underground supply crates[/color] full of deactivated telecrystals are ordered from the station's cargo request console for 20,000 each. Ordering one alerts the [color=cyan]TSFMC[/color], who will be looking for the courier. Deactivated telecrystals also give off a thermal signature, so don't carry too many.
A crate sold at its destination pays the courier 30,000 and sends ten telecrystals to the UndergroundVend. The TSFMC is told about the sale as well, so get out quick.
## The fence and the drop
The fence vendor sells [color=crimson]smuggling crates[/color]. Only one station in the sector buys them at a time: the [bold]drop[/bold]. Your Market app names the drop under its Underground tab and tells you when it moves. Security hears where it is ten minutes later.
The fence chute buys freight that still has its manifest seal, such as cargo taken off NPC haulers, at full price and off the books.
## The price on your head
- A [color=crimson]Fugitive[/color] is worth [bold]150[/bold] [color=yellow]FMC[/color] to the TSFMC. - The [color=purple]Godfather[/color] is worth [bold]400[/bold] [color=yellow]FMC[/color].
Both are paid for a live prisoner, and your captors have to offer the Underground bail first.
The [color=tan]Sultanate[/color] also looks into everyone on the station. About half of you will be marked a [color=red][bold]heretic[/bold][/color] some time in your first hour, and the [color=tan]PDV[/color] is paid to hand you over. They have to challenge you first.
[italic][color=gray](This is why the Godfather and Fugitives can't take the Heretic trait: the job already rolls for it.)[/color][/italic]
